name: EIA Form 923 Power Plant Operations Data
known_limitations: Monthly and early annual releases can be revised and use different reporting populations; plant generation does not prove local deliverability or customer service capacity.
automation_notes: Preserve plant code, reporting month, release vintage, generation, fuel, receipts, stocks, and revision status.
notes: Plant-level operating rail for generation, fuel consumption, stocks, receipts, and selected environmental data.
